title: Air Station Sacramento sends Aid to Assist Tsunami Victims
description: B-roll of the Coast Guard sending aid and supplies to tsunami victims in American Samoa. Scenes include trucks loading equipment onto planes, interviews with workers and a shot of the plane taking off. Produced by Petty Officer 3rd Class Levi Read and Petty Officer 3rd Class Kevin Metcalf. pacificrelief
